| Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Fri, Jun 12** | **Île de la Cité + Notre-Dame area**; easy riverside start, photo stops, short walk; **Transit:** 15–25 min from central Paris | **Seine cruise + Tuileries Garden**; low-effort first day, playground time for child; **Transit:** 10–20 min between stops | **Eiffel Tower area at sunset**; picnic or casual dinner nearby; **Transit:** 20–30 min from Tuileries |
| **Sat, Jun 13** | **Cité des Sciences / Parc de la Villette**; best “one museum day” with interactive exhibits; **Transit:** 25–40 min | **Canal Saint-Martin + snack stop**; relaxed stroll, boat locks, ice cream; **Transit:** 20–30 min | **Montmartre evening walk**; Sacré-Cœur viewpoint, street atmosphere, early dinner; **Transit:** 20–35 min |
| **Sun, Jun 14** | **Jardin du Luxembourg + playground time**; slow family morning, boat pond, open space; **Transit:** 15–25 min | **Latin Quarter / Shakespeare & Company area**; light browsing, lunch, easy wandering; **Transit:** 10–20 min | **Seine-side dinner or Champs-Élysées stroll**; finish with a simple family-friendly meal; **Transit:** 20–30 min |

## Budget Plan for 3 Days
| Category | Estimated Cost |
|---|---:|
| Accommodation, 2 nights | **EUR 420–520** |
| Food and drinks | **EUR 180–240** |
| Local transit | **EUR 35–55** |
| Activities and entry fees | **EUR 120–180** |
| Snacks, ice cream, extras | **EUR 40–70** |
| Buffer | **EUR 50–80** |
| **Total** | **EUR 845–1,145** |

### Best-fit budget choice
- To stay **at or under EUR 900**, target:
  - accommodation around **EUR 430–470**
  - food around **EUR 180–200**
  - activities capped at **EUR 120–140**
- Best savings:
  - use **metro + walking**
  - choose **1 paid attraction per day max**
  - do **picnic lunches** in parks

## Family-Friendly Pace and Transit
- **Day 1:** light sightseeing, mostly outdoors, good arrival-day energy.
- **Day 2:** the only more indoor/structured day, so the next day stays outdoors and relaxed.
- **Day 3:** park + neighborhood wandering, which avoids back-to-back museum fatigue.
- Estimated daily movement: **45–90 minutes total transit** depending on hotel location.
